detail.longDescription: Nvidia expands NVLink Fusion strategy to supercharge custom silicon memory Nvidia launched NVHBM, a custom die base boosting memory bandwidth by 30% and cutting power by 15%. It integrates memory controllers into 3D HBM stacks, giving partner companies like Amazon, Qualcomm, and Arm greater design flexibility for custom chips. This enables more capable processors for handling larger AI models with faster data retrieval. https://www. sdxcentral.com/news/nvidia-exp ands-nvlink-fusion-strategy-to-supercharge-custom-silicon-memory/ # AI # MachineLearning
